components.name: Access Lattice
components.description: Five carved apertures; as many lit as the API is open. Mirrors in RTL.
components.html: <svg class="ds-lattice" viewBox="0 0 56 14" role="img" aria-label="Access: Registration, 2 of 5, from open to restricted"><rect x="0.5" y="0.5" width="55" height="13" rx="1" class="frame"/><rect x="3" y="4" width="6" height="6" transform="rotate(45 6 7)" class="open"/><rect x="14" y="4" width="6" height="6" transform="rotate(45 17 7)" class="open"/><rect x="25" y="4" width="6" height="6" transform="rotate(45 28 7)" class="open"/><rect x="36" y="4" width="6" height="6" transform="rotate(45 39 7)" class="open"/><rect x="47" y="4" width="6" height="6" transform="rotate(45 50 7)" class="shut"/></svg>
components.css: .ds-lattice { width: 56px; height: 14px; } .ds-lattice .frame { fill: none; stroke: oklch(0.34 0.045 50 / 0.4); } .ds-lattice .open { fill: oklch(0.5 0.085 192); } .ds-lattice .shut { fill: oklch(0.84 0.016 65); } [dir=rtl] .ds-lattice { transform: scaleX(-1); }

narrative.overview: The directory reads like the carved wooden window screens of Jeddah's old town: dense, ordered panels of fine teak rules on coral stone, where light comes through only where the screen is open. Here the light is access: every API carries a carved lattice lit as far as it is open. The rest stays quiet and standard: an Operate surface where developers find things before they notice the world, in Arabic and English alike.
keyCharacteristics: Coral-stone ground and teak ink; one accent, the rawashin turquoise.
Ruled rows and panels with hairline teak borders and near-square corners.
The access lattice on every API, lit by the access filter.
One family (Readex Pro) for Arabic and Latin; JetBrains Mono only for code.

rules.name: The Light Is Access Rule
rules.body: Turquoise marks openness and action, never decoration.

rules.name: The Stone Not Cream Rule
rules.body: The ground stays grey stone at chroma 0.006.

rules.name: The Code Is LTR Rule
rules.body: Code, URLs and identifiers stay left-to-right inside Arabic pages.

rules.name: The Flat Facade Rule
rules.body: No decorative shadows; tone and hairline rules separate surfaces.

dos: Do show access with the lattice and its word together.
Do keep lists as ruled rows with facts readable in the row.
Do write every UI string in both message files.
Do use logical spacing and position utilities so pages mirror.
donts: Don't put a kicker or eyebrow label above a heading.
Don't lay out APIs as a grid of same-size cards.
Don't warm the ground into cream or add wood or stone textures.
Don't use monospace for anything that is not code, a URL or an identifier.
